meta.title: Hidden Edge - 3
meta.description: Facing the foe head on can be a wise strategy too.

units.rawText: You have nowhere to run, Odile.
units.displayText: You have nowhere to run, Odile.

spans.text: You have nowhere to run, Odile.

units.rawText: So the Hero and the Church have joined forces, and together they reach the conclusion by dint of courage and obsession...
units.displayText: So the Hero and the Church have joined forces, and together they reach the conclusion by dint of courage and obsession...

spans.text: So the Hero and the Church have joined forces, and together they reach the conclusion by dint of courage and obsession...

units.rawText: But their foolishness in mistaking a cramped locale as this for the scene of the grand finale has led to a tragic close.
units.displayText: But their foolishness in mistaking a cramped locale as this for the scene of the grand finale has led to a tragic close.

spans.text: But their foolishness in mistaking a cramped locale as this for the scene of the grand finale has led to a tragic close.

units.rawText: Come, my obedient cast of actors. Rip them to shreds!
units.displayText: Come, my obedient cast of actors. Rip them to shreds!

spans.text: Come, my obedient cast of actors. Rip them to shreds!

units.rawText: Faith's eyes gleam with cold light in response to the sounds of the churning hordes of Entropics outside the narrow passage.
units.displayText: Faith's eyes gleam with cold light in response to the sounds of the churning hordes of Entropics outside the narrow passage.

spans.text: Faith's eyes gleam with cold light in response to the sounds of the churning hordes of Entropics outside the narrow passage.

units.rawText: [In accordance with Sanctifier Enforcement Regulations Chapter 9 Clause 27, I am disengaging all inhibitions to cleanse the Irregular Agent.]
units.displayText: [In accordance with Sanctifier Enforcement Regulations Chapter 9 Clause 27, I am disengaging all inhibitions to cleanse the Irregular Agent.]

spans.text: [In accordance with Sanctifier Enforcement Regulations Chapter 9 Clause 27, I am disengaging all inhibitions to cleanse the Irregular Agent.]

units.rawText: ...Huh. Is this the knight's hidden strength? It makes for a fine tale.
units.displayText: ...Huh. Is this the knight's hidden strength? It makes for a fine tale.

spans.text: ...Huh. Is this the knight's hidden strength? It makes for a fine tale.

units.rawText: Let us see if you are swamped first, or if your allies and faithful subordinates must all be dragged down before that!
units.displayText: Let us see if you are swamped first, or if your allies and faithful subordinates must all be dragged down before that!

spans.text: Let us see if you are swamped first, or if your allies and faithful subordinates must all be dragged down before that!

units.rawText: I will not be beaten by the Daemons, and neither will the allies of the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: I will not be beaten by the Daemons, and neither will the allies of the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: I will not be beaten by the Daemons, and neither will the allies of the Sanctifiers.
